meta.title: Frankencoin for treasuries: companies, funds and DAOs
meta.description: Hold part of your on-chain reserves in Swiss francs and let idle balances earn the protocol rate. Safe multisig, accounting reports, custody and public legal assessments.

hero.title: Diversify your treasury|into Swiss francs.
hero.subtitle: Hold part of your on-chain reserves in francs rather than only dollars, and let idle balances earn the protocol rate in the savings module.

items.title: Currency diversification
items.description: Hold the franc next to USD stablecoins without leaving the chain.

items.title: Productive balances
items.description: ZCHF deposited in the savings module earns the protocol rate and can be withdrawn any time. The Savings Vault (svZCHF) gives the same as one tradable token.

items.title: No issuer, no bank
items.description: No company can freeze or redeem your balance. ZCHF is backed by over-collateralized positions you can inspect on-chain.

ops.title: What your team will ask for

items.title: Safe multisig
items.description: The app runs inside Safe's interface, so deposits and withdrawals follow your signing policy.

items.title: Accounting reports
items.description: Yearly reports of interest and holdings per address, ready for your accountant.

items.title: Institutional custody
items.description: Supported by institutional custodians in the ecosystem.

items.title: Legal and audits
items.description: Public Swiss and EU (MiCA) legal assessments of how ZCHF is classified, and eight audits by four firms.

dao.title: For DAOs
dao.subtitle: A ZCHF allocation in savings earns the protocol rate in a second currency. Holding FCS (Frankencoin Shares) adds a vote on new collateral and a stake in the equity reserve, with the price risk that comes with equity.

cta.title: Planning an allocation?
cta.body: The Frankencoin Association walks treasury teams through custody, accounting and liquidity for larger amounts.
